🌟What is Personal Care🌟 
Personal care is all about helping you or loved ones with daily activities to maintain independence and quality of life. From bathing and dressing to companionship and meal prep, our caregivers at Active Home Health, Hospice and Personal Care are here to support you every step of the way 🧡💙💛
Watch the full video to learn how we can help!

Hospice focuses on comfort and support when curative care no longer helps. Personal care offers daily living help like bathing, dressing, meal prep, and companionship. Understanding these differences helps you choose the right service at the right time. 🌟 ￼ Call us to learn which care fits your needs.
